_comment: Neutral animation sets: elemental summons, Odin (elder), divine manifestations, jungle monsters (small/medium/large), and goblin minions. Import via Tools > Project D > Import Neutral Animations. Objectives include a reward-grant flourish.

signatureA.animatorNotes: Rear back, inhale (0.45), then breathe a wide fire cone; scorched-ground residue during active. Heavy stomp recovery.

signatureB.animatorNotes: Leaping fist-slam that cracks the ground; expanding fire rings on impact.

neutrals.notes: Fire summon. Big, aggressive body language. On death, kneel and shatter into embers while the Infernal Favor blessing streams to the killing team.

signatureA.animatorNotes: Graceful arm sweep spawns delayed ice crystals in lanes, then a radial frost burst. Elegant, unhurried.

neutrals.notes: Ice summon. Serene, dancer-like motion; brief slow applied by ability hits.

signatureA.animatorNotes: Raise the staff; a telegraphed bolt marks the ground then chains between nearby targets. Patriarchal, deliberate.

neutrals.notes: Lightning summon.

signatureA.animatorNotes: Beat the wings to spawn cyclones and displacing gusts; rotating safe sectors. Fast, erratic, avian.

neutrals.notes: Wind summon; grants move+attack speed.

signatureA.animatorNotes: Massive double-fist ground pound sends cracking lines forward; falling-rock markers then a frontal slam. Immense weight; slow everything.

neutrals.notes: Earth summon; defensive blessing.

signatureA.animatorNotes: Serpentine rear-and-crash; a tidal sweep with water lanes and knock-up circles. Sinuous, flowing spine motion.

neutrals.notes: Water summon; regen + resource blessing near river.

signatureA.animatorNotes: Rear the mount, level the spear, and hurl a long telegraphed line. Regal, terrifying poise.

signatureB.animatorNotes: Sleipnir gallops across the arena trampling all in the lane; long root-motion charge.

signatureUltimate.animatorNotes: THE finisher. A long, dread-building unsheathe (0.90) with the whole arena darkening, then a single horizontal cut that executes low-HP heroes and slays neutral summons. The killing team receives Zantetsuken's Edge — grant flourish on recovery. Camera + hitstop moment.

neutrals.notes: Elder objective boss. Mounted, three signatures, a low-HP enrage, and a screen-defining ultimate.

signatureA.animatorNotes: A slow, imperious ranged smite so the manifestation can defend its pit. Low mobility by design.
